description.value:
Thresher models were developed with durability in mind and are built to be rugged, powerful, and festooned with defensive attachments. Your frame might have been constructed for combat, salvage, recovery operations, or heavy construction. Your sturdier design elements allow you a measure of protection not found in other frames. You treat your Strength modifier as 2 higher for the purposes of meeting the Strength requirements of armor.

In addition, you gain an integrated commercial dermal plating augmentation that doesn't count against your total implant limit and doesn't cost you any credits. You can improve the grade of this augmentation as normal by paying the difference in credits between its current grade and the intended grade.
